name: lens-strip
title: Lens strip
description: A strip of pictures sliding behind a fixed lens of thick glass that magnifies the one in it, bends it at the bevelled rim with faint colour fringes, and smears it a little while moving. WebGL, with a DOM fallback.

props.name: images
props.description: The pictures, in order. Pictures from another origin must send CORS headers, or they show as empty cards.

props.name: index
props.description: Controlled: the picture in the lens.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The picture in the lens at first, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called when the strip heads for a new picture: on release, a key, a button or a click.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap round from the last picture to the first.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Picture width over height. The lens takes the same shape.

props.name: magnify
props.description: How much larger the strip looks through the lens.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: How strongly the glass splits light into colour at its rim, from 0 (none) to 1.

props.name: labels
props.description: Screen reader and button text with English defaults. Keys: `previous`, `next`, `picture` and `of`.

a11y.text: The carousel is one Tab stop. ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between pictures, Home and End jump to the ends. The focus ring is drawn around the stage.

The pictures are real images with alt text and are always in the DOM, also when WebGL is missing or lost. Slides that are not current are aria-hidden and inert. The visible caption is aria-hidden; a polite live region reads the title and the position.
Under reduced motion every move jumps, the lens shows no motion smear, and the caption fade is skipped.
